name: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
description: A savory appetizer featuring large mushrooms filled with a crab meat and cheese mixture, baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup grated Emmenthal or Gruyère cheese, divided

recipeInstructions.text: Wipe mushrooms with lemon juice. Remove stems for stuffing and set caps aside.
Trim and chop stems. In a saucepan, melt butter. Add onion and chopped mushroom stems. Cook until mushroom stems are tender and moisture has evaporated.
Stir in drained crab meat, 1/4 cup cheese, 1 tablespoon cracker crumbs, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Spoon stuffing into mushroom caps and place on greased baking dish.
Combine remaining 1/4 cup cheese and 1 teaspoon cracker crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over stuffed mushrooms.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Bake in 400°F oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Crab & Cheese Platter
_similar.description: A layered seafood appetizer featuring a creamy cheese base topped with cocktail sauce and crab meat.
recipeIngredient: 2 large packages (8 oz each) cream cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise and onion flakes in a blender, or beat with an electric mixer, until smooth and creamy.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the surface of a large round platter, leaving room around the outside for a row of crackers.
Press the centre of the cheese mixture down lightly to make a slightly raised border, about ½ to 1 in wide, around the outer edge.
Spread seafood cocktail sauce over the cheese layer within this border, leaving an outside rim of the cheese layer showing.
Drain the crab meat and spread it over the sauce layer, again leaving a border of seafood sauce showing.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, layered platter, seafood appetizer

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.
